title: Bell and Winter
author: Ada Quintana
blurb: August Oyelaran, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
